
# 1. Carga y Limpieza de Datos

```{r carga_limpieza}
library(tidyverse)
library(moments)

df <- read_csv("devops_metrics.csv")

df_clean <- df %>%
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(
    priority = factor(priority, levels = c("baja", "media", "alta", "crítica"), ordered = TRUE),
    team = as.factor(team),
    module = as.factor(module),
    deploy_status = as.factor(deploy_status)
  )

glimpse(df_clean)
```

# 2. Estadística Descriptiva Univariada

```{r descriptiva}
df_clean %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(build_time_min, deploy_time_min, test_coverage_pct, 
        ticket_resolution_h, commit_size_loc, num_bugs),
      list(
        media     = ~ round(mean(.x), 2),
        mediana   = ~ round(median(.x), 2),
        sd        = ~ round(sd(.x), 2),
        iqr       = ~ round(IQR(.x), 2),
        cv        = ~ round(sd(.x) / mean(.x), 2),
        asimetria = ~ round(skewness(.x), 2)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = c("variable", "medida"), names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = medida, values_from = value)
```

# 3. Tablas de Frecuencia (Sturges)

```{r frecuencias}
N <- nrow(df_clean)
k <- ceiling(1 + 3.322 * log10(N))

df_clean %>%
  mutate(clase = cut(build_time_min, breaks = k, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  count(clase, name = "fa") %>%
  mutate(
    fr = round(fa / sum(fa), 4),
    fr_pct = round(fr * 100, 2),
    fac = cumsum(fa)
  )
```

# 4. Comparación por Grupos y Correlaciones

```{r grupos}
# Resumen por equipo
df_clean %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(
    eventos = n(),
    mediana_build = round(median(build_time_min), 2),
    promedio_bugs = round(mean(num_bugs), 2),
    pct_fallos = round(mean(deploy_status == "failed") * 100, 2)
  )

# Matriz de Correlación
df_clean %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs") %>%
  round(2)
```

# 5. Visualizaciones Clave

```{r graficos, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
theme_set(theme_minimal())

# Histograma
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = build_time_min)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = k, fill = "#0284c7", color = "#ffffff") +
  labs(title = "Distribución del Tiempo de Build", x = "Minutos", y = "Frecuencia")

# Boxplot
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = team, y = ticket_resolution_h, fill = team)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Resolución de Tickets por Equipo", x = "Equipo", y = "Horas")

# Barras
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = priority, fill = deploy_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Estado de Despliegue según Prioridad", x = "Prioridad", y = "Cantidad")

# Dispersión
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = commit_size_loc, y = num_bugs)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, color = "#2563eb") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#dc2626") +
  labs(title = "Tamaño de Commit vs Bugs", x = "Líneas de Código", y = "Bugs")
```
